answer: An operator copying one text across 47 aliases therefore pays for 47 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the dawn hash is stored at intake, the comet graph groups the endorsements and the river audit exposes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
